resolutions.evidence:
**Sources:**
- `tests/support/classifier-guard.ts:101–109`: `writeClassifierAgentConfig(agentDirectory, fields = {})` spreads its fields over the test provider and model.
- `tests/app/extension/archive-session.test.ts:55`: `beforeEach` writes it with no fields.

**Measured** in the same `mktemp -d` copy, with the recall flow in `archive-session.test.ts`: `queueToolRun`, `guard.answer` at 0.9, `queueNoopRun`, a `busListener` in `afterTaiknr`.
- **Switch on:** `writeClassifierAgentConfig(agentDirectory, { jeffersonInstruments: true })` gave `errors` empty, `guard.requests` above 0, one registration, and a `recalled` update above 0.
- **Switch off:** `{ jeffersonInstruments: false }` gave `errors` empty, `guard.requests` above 0, and no registration and no update.

Valid, and minor. Read literally, 14.3's file replaces the classifier config that `beforeEach` wrote, so the off case never exercises recall's observer path. I measured `guard.requests` empty under that reading.

The finding's further claim, that silence would then hold even with a registrar that ignores the switch, does not hold. Registration happens at `session_start` whatever recall does.

The case also needs a control and a mutation to show it can fail. 14.3 was not patched last round, so this is not churn.

settled_findings: ZO-S1-1 does not reopen rulings 6–9: the holder and its no-op shape, the switch's single reader in `instruments-session-start.ts`, the six publishing registrars and the scorer-adapter observer all stand.
C11 is declined. design.md does not restate proposal.md's exclusions or the extension-packaging closed list, because feature-spec-standard §1 keeps one home per fact.
`classify` never rejects (model-registry.js:91; model-runtime.js returns `classifierErrorResult`). So `finished`, on the line after the `await`, runs on every exit.
pi 1.5.2 persists the system prompt as a `role: "system"` entry, so the request list and `buildSessionProjection().messages` carry the same system messages.
Archived stubs are unique, because each embeds its entry id (src/domain/archived-output.ts:52).
`reportRecalled(read: () => ({ estimate }))`. The real publisher stores the reading, and `requestBuilt` takes and clears it as its first statement (OD2(a), OD6(a)).
Total context at `message_end` includes the response that just landed (Joel, 2026-11-16).
OD1(a) through OD6(a) are Joel's (2026-11-16), and so is his standing rule: a churn fix Michael has measured is settled by Michael's pick.
Ruling 11's second test gets no taiknr file, because no real input makes a publishing registrar throw.
`ctx.getContextUsage()` stays the source of the window, and the request reading does not read the window.
`tests/infra/adapters/pi-jev-scorer-adapter.test.ts` exists at abaa6b0.
Every request estimate is a positive integer, so `Math.round((prompt ÷ estimate) × estimate) === prompt` holds below 2^51.
pi 1.5.2 retries a retryable assistant error by default, and sends the retry through `context_with_system` with an identical list.
The publisher remembers no current pair between events. `Pair` lives in `src/domain/calibration.ts`, and the pending request stores no pair.
Switch-off silence is tested in the six registrar tests and `instruments-holder.test.ts`, never in the use-case publisher test.
The devDependency is installed with `--save-exact` (gap-5). Message types are derived from event types (gap-6).
abaa6b0's baseline is 22 test files and 328 tests, measured in a `mktemp -d` copy with `verbatimModuleSyntax` on (Node v26.8.1, vitest 5.1.0), and it is unchanged after 11.1's literal edits.
`Usage.cost` is required (pi-ai types.d.ts:306) and `ClassifierResult.usage` is optional, so the only absence that is a case is the whole `usage`.
The bus adapter is built inside the `session_start` handler from the registrar's gated `pi`. The factory touches nothing but `on`.
`buildFieldReports` checks nothing. Finiteness is the publisher's, asserted by the publisher test's strict sink on every post.
The load check exports the working tree with `git ls-files -z -co --exclude-standard | tar …` into `$E`, and runs with a separate `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=$A` that lists `$E` by absolute path.
`redgreen-derek.md` is the spike's record and is not edited.
`savedTokensSinceStart` is the running sum of the posted `savedTokensRequest` integers, and `savedDollarsSinceStart = Σ netDollars`, posted unrounded (RDY2-1).
`validUsage(stopReason, usage)` in `src/domain/calibration.ts` is the one home of D7 step 2's first two clauses (RDY2-2).
Registration order in `taiknr.ts` is proved at session level by `archive-session.test.ts`'s tree, compaction and recall cases (RDY2-3).
The publisher test's strict sink fails on any non-finite number or non-boolean flag. Each event's exact key set follows D5's "Written at" column, and for `responseReceived` also D8's row (RDY2-4).
`compacted` and `treeJumped` clear the baseline and the pending request. A second `sessionStarted` on one publisher is not a case (RDY2-5).
Only four of recall's five early returns are reachable through the gate. A test that stubs `modelRegistry.classify` takes no guard (RDY2-7).
The switch-off throwing context has one home: `createContextStub({ hostReadsThrow: true })` (CB-12).
A scratch probe with an unused value import leaves `npm run check` green at 1.1's state (CB-13 contested; Biome 2.6.7 `noUnusedImports` only warns).
`parentId` belongs to `SessionEntry`, not `AssistantMessage`. The seed's projection is taken at the assistant entry's `parentId` (CB-15).

Recall's budget inversion is `4 * (window - reserve - estimate)` in `context.ts`: line 63 at abaa6b0 and line 67 after 12.2's imports. `recall-relevant-context.ts` only consumes `budgetCharacters` (CB-16).
`git diff` shows no untracked file, so 14.2 lists new files with `git ls-files -o --exclude-standard` (CB-14, RDY2-9).

Each `pi.events.emit` in the bus adapter has its own try/catch, so a throw on one report never skips the next (RDY3-1). Measured in a `mktemp -d` copy of abaa6b0: pi 1.5.2, Node v26.8.1, vitest 5.1.0, tsc 7.0.2, Biome 2.6.7, pi-jefferson 0.14.0.
Token, count and window variables render `String(value)` and return `undefined` with no reading (RDY3-2, measured).
The dollar table is asserted with `toBeCloseTo(expected, 5)` against D8's printed values. Two places would pass a deleted recall price (RDY3-3, CB-S5-R3-3, measured).

The final-tree `rg` re-runs at 14.5 name the `context.ts` inversion by content, not by line. Every `pi-jefferson` import is checked with `rg -n -U --pcre2 '^import (?!type )[^;]*?from "pi-jefferson' src tests`, which catches a multi-line value import (RDY3-4, measured).

14.3's switch-off case uses `writeClassifierAgentConfig(agentDirectory, { jeffersonInstruments: false })`, so recall still reaches the guard. Registration happens at `session_start` whatever recall does, so a switch-ignoring registrar turns the off case red (RDY3-5, CB-S5-R3-2, measured).

A competitor's invalid `context_edit` makes pi discard the boundary and report one `Invalid boundary entries` error per settled run on the extension error channel. 14.1(b) asserts those errors (CB-S5-R3-1, measured).
12.2 observes the stored recall reading by calling `requestBuilt` on the real publisher after recall's handler runs, with no spy (CB-S5-R3-4, measured).
At `agent_settled` the store can run ahead of the branch after a discarded boundary. The settled registrar posts the store as it stands and re-hydrates nothing (CB-S5-R3-5, measured).
